independent_reconstruction_limits: No new physical integration, model propagation, geometry query, optimization, neural inference or training was performed.
Saved distance minima and all associated states/identities were independently reduced and cross-checked; pairwise distance geometry is not recomputed.
Native geometry centers/rotations and model geom_rbound are not in original native arrays: original maximum_geometry_step_m is recorded evidence, not independently reconstructed in this script.

All stored base generalized momentum components are reduced independently; native full mass matrices and momentum_exchange arrays were not saved, so momentum values from qpos/qvel and relative scale cannot be independently reconstructed without dynamics evaluation.
Model numerical residual scalars are saved and pass their gates; underlying solves/mass matrices were not saved for independent residual reconstruction.

Near records are exhaustively partitioned and selection rules independently reproduced; saved minima/near tables cannot prove absence of a producer omission from an unsaved exact all-pair distance list.
No physical causal advantage is inferred from selected constraints, saved near distances, or later body shape observations.
